retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor Membrane encompasses the broader family of ProctorWrap
and ProctorPassive technical building fabrics engineered for Australian climate
zones. These spunbonded polyolefin and composite membranes serve as Class 3 or
Class 4 vapour-permeable, airtight, and water-barrier layers across wall
assemblies and pitched roofs. By allowing structural moisture to escape while
blocking external liquid water and wind-driven draughts, they protect building
durability and enhance thermal insulation efficiency.
